assessment.label: looseness
assessment.reason: Query shows elevated 1x on all channels (ch0 0.01017, ch1 0.00621, ch2 0.01552, ch3 0.00373) unlike normal (~0.0003-0.0016) and misalignment (~0.0003-0.0012) references where 1x stays low. Unlike unbalance references where 1x dominates 2x/3x (e.g., 0.01379 vs 0.00194, 0.01786 vs 0.00529), query has multiple harmonics co-elevated: ch0 2x 0.00958 and 3x 0.01214 >=1x, ch2 2x 0.00837 and 3x 0.00563, ch3 3x 0.00447 >1x. This multi-harmonic elevation with 3x comparable to or exceeding 1x matches looseness references (e.g., 1x 0.01045/2x 0.00358/3x 0.01052 and 1x 0.01420/2x 0.01311/3x 0.02426; low-rms looseness 1x 0.00751/2x 0.00772/3x 0.00486). RMS level ~0.027-0.031 also matches low-rms looseness reference ~0.022-0.028 vs higher normal/unbalance ~0.036-0.052. Limitation: only four channels and one short recording supplied, radial sensitivity and overlap between unbalance and looseness 1x elevation mean fault cannot be uniquely isolated without more data.

Need ch3 to confirm.
